notes.title: Patch Notes - v0.7.4
notes.content:
We've just pushed a big update for Beneath The Six! This patch focuses on significant balancing changes for daily challenges and player levelling, introduces new ways to revive your party, and crushes a huge number of bugs based on your reports.

[h3]Content[/h3]
[list]
[*]The [b]Fairy Wing[/b] has been reworked. It can now be consumed to revive all dead or downed players for 50 health. It also retains an auto-revive function upon your own death.
[*]An option to revive downed or dead players is now available in the shop in both the dungeon and the Arena.
[*]Prayer Altars will now revive any dead or downed players in the party.
[/list]

[h3]Balancing[/h3]
[list]
[*]Daily Challenges have been made easier based on your feedback. Specific kill counts have been reduced:
[list]
[*][b]Kill enemies:[/b] 50 -> 30
[*][b]Kill enemies using backstab:[/b] 20 -> 10
[*][b]Kill enemies whilst they're stunned:[/b] 20 -> 10
[*][b]Kill enemies whilst they're bleeding:[/b] 20 -> 10
[*][b]Kill enemies whilst they're poisoned:[/b] 20 -> 10
[/list]
[*]The levelling system has been reworked to remove level restrictions and reduce health gain per level.
[*]The full health regeneration upon levelling up has been nerfed, as it was too generous in multiplayer.
[*]Weapon upgrading in shops has been limited.
[/list]

[h3]Improvements & Quality of Life[/h3]
[list]
[*]Daily and weekly challenges now progress while playing in the Arena.
[*]The number of turns taken in the Arena will now be included in the Discord leaderboard updates.
[*]The Spear has its VFX back, and SFX have been added for the throw and impact of the Hurl Weapon skill.
[/list]

[h3]Bug Fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*]Fixed a [b]critical bug[/b] where toggling the 'Hide Helmet' option could wipe the player's inventory.
[*]Resolved an issue where the End Game screen failed to populate stats, often only showing 'GOLD COLLECTED'.
[*]Corrected a logic issue in the leaderboard where having 'More turns' was incorrectly ranked higher than 'Less turns'.
[*]Fixed a session-breaking bug where using Temporal Displacement Armour with a Potion of Hot Footed could cause a player to teleport indefinitely.
[*]Chests and 'TRY YOUR LUCK' stashes should no longer appear empty.
[*]Fixed an issue where random dungeons were incorrectly using the same rooms as the daily dungeon.
[*]Addressed a bug where bow kills were not counting as kills from range.
[*]The camera follower should no longer break if you move it far away from the player and press SPACE.
[*]Corrected an issue where avatar portraits would fail to load and appear grey.
[*]Fixed multiple issues with the Arena map screen, including a non-functional button and missing graphics.
[*]Resolved a bug where illusions created by the Scroll of Fragmentation were not attacking enemies.
[/list]

Thank you for all your feedback, it has been invaluable to us. We read and log everything, so if you have reported something which isn't mentioned in the above notes, keep a look out for future updates as it may well be there!

[i]Happy dungeon-crawling![/i]

notes.title: Patch Notes - v0.7.2
notes.content:
[p]We've just pushed a new update to Beneath The Six, including endless random dungeons, a shorter more intense arena experience and some general balancing. We've also improved the user flow to help highlight how the player can earn golden shards through completing challenges.[/p][p][/p][p]Patch notes:[/p][p]
[u][b]Content[/b][/u][/p][list][*][p]Random dungeons are now enabled, so you can now play endless dungeons as well as the daily.[/p][/*][/list][p]
[u][b]Balancing[/b][/u][/p][list][*][p]You can now escape after 5 rounds instead of 10, but can still continue on as far as you can manage[/p][/*][*][p]Changes to arena difficulty scaling to match this[/p][/*][/list][p]
[u][b]General Quality Of Life[/b][/u] [/p][list][*][p]Added a link from the Challenge screen to the shop when a player doesn't have enough Golden Shards[/p][/*][*][p]The challenges menu is now open by default in the title screen[/p][/*][*][p]Players will now be notified when a player joins their lobby[/p][/*][/list][p]
[u][b]Pricing changes[/b][/u][/p][list][*][p]Tokens for random dice chests now costs 500 golden shards, compared to previously costing 1000. We will be re-imbursing players who purchased crates at the previous price with the difference in golden shards.[/p][/*][/list][p][u][b]
Bug Fixes[/b][/u][/p][list][*][p]Fixed an initialization bug that caused the game to fail when an item with a duplicate key was added[/p][/*][*][p]Resolved a bug where opening a Dice Token would not close the inventory screen, blocking the player's view of the chest[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where the in-game menu would get messed up after using the -resetPrefs command[/p][/*][*][p]Corrected an issue with the Boss Small Stone Golem where its teleport animation was missing, making its movement look janky[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug that would sometimes cause the game to start on a permanent black screen when joining a lobby thats just starting up[/p][/*][*][p]Resolved a bug with 'ACRANISTS ESCAPE' where it wasn’t working as intended, but now enemies are rooted[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where the buy button on the Buy Shard screen was slightly misaligned[/p][/*][*][p]Improved the Voice Over timing when discovering a new room in dungeon[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed several issues related to the Boss Reveal and Defeat animations[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]Thank you for all your feedback, it has been invaluable to us. We read and log everything, so if you have reported something which isn't mentioned in the above notes, keep a look out for future updates as it may well be there![/p][p]Happy goblin hunting...[/p]

notes.title: Patch Notes - v0.7.1
notes.content: [p]We've just pushed a new update with a number of fixes and improvements based on player feedback and bug reports.[/p][p][/p][p][b]We heard you[/b] - It should now be a bit clearer how you can earn golden shards by completing daily and weekly challenges. We are still working on improving this - so keep your eyes and ears open![/p][p][/p][p]We are working towards our more in-depth roadmap which we will be releasing soon. Thank you for your continued support and feedback you've given so far, its been extremely helpful![/p][p][/p][p][u][b]New Features & Changes[/b][/u][/p][list][*][p]A new notification icon will now appear when you have unclaimed rewards.[/p][/*][*][p]The Title Screen UI has been updated to allow you to enable settings and challenges at the same time.[/p][/*][*][p]The Challenges screen will now automatically open on the title screen upon loading the game.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][u][b]Bug Fixes[/b][/u][/p][list][*][p]Fixed a bug where the 'List View', 'Grid View', and 'All' buttons in the Dice Store were not working correctly.[/p][/*][*][p]Resolved an issue where holding and dragging your cursor on an empty inventory slot would cause the cursor to become hidden.[/p][/*][*][p]Corrected a major bug where closing the arena map screen would disable all UI.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a problem where the gameplay UI would be hidden after exiting the Arena Map screen.[/p][/*][*][p]Resolved a visual bug where the 'START' button was clipping off-screen in the Arena.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a critical desync bug that occurred in multiplayer sessions when double-clicking on the 'Purse of Gilded Sovereigns' item.[/p][/*][*][p]Corrected a bug that allowed more than 4 players to enter an online session.[/p][/*][*][p]Resolved an issue that caused UI to be blocked on specific Mac devices.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][u][b]Improvements[/b][/u][/p][list][*][p]Added a helpful hint to the title screen to guide players to the Challenges.[/p][/*][*][p]Improved the first-time user experience for the initial dungeon run.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]We know this patch doesn't cover everything you've sent us, but please know that we're listening and every single report gets read and logged.[/p][p]Your detailed and constructive feedback is invaluable, and it truly helps us make [b]Beneath The Six[/b] better.[/p][p]Thanks again for your patience and support. Happy dungeon-crawling![/p]

tags.feature: A new notification icon will now appear when you have unclaimed rewards.
The Title Screen UI has been updated to allow you to enable settings and challenges at the same time.
The Challenges screen will now automatically open on the title screen upon loading the game.

tags.bug: Fixed a bug where the 'List View', 'Grid View', and 'All' buttons in the Dice Store were not working correctly.
Resolved an issue where holding and dragging your cursor on an empty inventory slot would cause the cursor to become hidden.
Corrected a major bug where closing the arena map screen would disable all UI.
Fixed a problem where the gameplay UI would be hidden after exiting the Arena Map screen.
Resolved a visual bug where the 'START' button was clipping off-screen in the Arena.
Fixed a critical desync bug that occurred in multiplayer sessions when double-clicking on the 'Purse of Gilded Sovereigns' item.
Corrected a bug that allowed more than 4 players to enter an online session.
Resolved an issue that caused UI to be blocked on specific Mac devices.

tags.feature: Added a helpful hint to the title screen to guide players to the Challenges.
Improved the first-time user experience for the initial dungeon run.
